name: 254. Code mode scripts can parse string results, and the stubs say how (code-mode-guidance) [SERIAL]
description:
The sandbox had no `json` module, so a result that arrived as a string could not be parsed in a script, and the stubs claimed every result was a dict while telling the model to print whole responses. These cases pin that `json` and `math` are available in executeToolCode, and that readToolFile and getToolDocs describe the real result shapes and point at `json.decode` instead of `print(result)`.

Serial, and it provisions its own client for the same reason as folder 210: a code-mode client makes the four meta-tools visible to every MCP-bearing request while it exists.
